Emboldened, the Moon gave more. The Sun retreated further, creating night. When dawn came, the Moon withdrew, and the Sun returned in full glory.

Thus they learned the dance of reciprocity—each taking turns, each trusting the other to return, each holding back their full power so both could flourish.

Their ancient bargain still governs our days and nights.
